newsitem.title: UK: UK Forties to load equiv 51 cargoes in Nov, down 3.
newsitem.headline: UK Forties to load equiv 51 cargoes in Nov, down 3.

text.p: November's U.K. North Sea Forties blend crude programme will consist of the equivalent of 51 standard 500,000-barrel cargoes, including the equivalent of three shipments direct to operator BP's Grangemouth refinery, traders said on Tuesday.
The November programme is just over three cargoes fewer than October's 54.3-cargo programme.
The November programme totals 25.5 million barrels, made up of 19 cargoes of 600,000 barrels, 23 of 500,000 barrels, one each of 630,000 and 485,000 barrels and 1.5 million barrels to BP's refinery.
October's total was 27.17 million barrels, including 1.55 million to Grangemouth.
